title: Rav Acha bar Abaye
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He discusses matters with Ravina, as in Shabbat 4a, where he raised a difficulty against Ravina; and where it says there “Rav Shila said: Actually,” Hyman proposes reading “Ravina said,” as in Dikdukei Soferim. Likewise in Bava Kamma 39b he raised a difficulty against Ravina: “Granted according to Abaye.” Hyman infers from this that he was not the son of Abaye without further designation.
